info.title: Membergy registration-v1
info.description: Executable current-base registration transport only. Existing /token supplies User Bearer; its Auth response is excluded. Canonical immutable tenant public_slug; existing numeric caller alias remains accepted but no numeric website URLs are generated. No public listing, payment block, me, Auth-v1/reset or CMS endpoints.

parameters.name: X-Membergy-Registration-Resume
parameters.description: Only the bound tenant, applicant, standard offer and version; never combine with User Bearer. Invalid/foreign 404; expired/revoked/stale 410. GET reads; successful new submission revokes. Identical key replay returns the original receipt until expiry.

post.description: One-use atomic exchange. Headless returns slug, applicant, standard offer, version, safe prefill and hash-only stored context bounded to link deadline and at most 60 minutes. No account creation. User Bearer is rejected for headless.
